item.title: Police: CT man threatened to kill two girls in a Panera parking lot
item.description: A 28-year-old man is facing several charges after police say he threatened to kill two minors in the parking lot of a Panera Bread in Wallingford, official said.

item.title: Look at what this UConn coach’s kid is doing now, and he’s batting a thousand doing it
item.description: Andrew Hurley, a graduate manager on his father's UConn men's basketball staff, has been in charge of the tablet and advising when to use the coach's challenge.

item.title: A different path: This CT hockey player opting for turf, not ice, in college
item.description: This CT high school athlete comes from an ice hockey family but she chose to play on turf, not ice, in college and everybody's on board with it.

item.title: CT officials approve UConn acquisition of Prospect-owned hospital
item.description: The Connecticut Office of Health Strategy on Friday evening approved a $13 million deal for the state's flagship medical institution — the University of Connecticut Health Center — to purchase Waterbury Hospital

item.title: Judge orders US to release 5-year-old and dad taken into custody in Minnesota crackdown
item.description: A judge on Saturday ordered the U.S. to release a 5-year-old boy and his father from a Texas detention center where they were taken after being detained in a Minneapolis suburb last month.

item.title: Braylon Mullins available to return as No. 2 UConn men’s basketball visits Creighton
item.description: UConn men's basketball freshman Braylon Mullins is expected to return Saturday night at Creighton after missing one game due to concussion protocol.

item.title: UConn women’s basketball seeks redemption in rivalry matchup vs. Tennessee: How to watch
item.description: The No. 1 UConn women's basketball team hosts longtime rival Tennessee on Sunday looking to avenge last year's stunning upset in Knoxville.

item.title: Daily Horoscope for February 01, 2026
item.description: Small choices reveal big needs for balance. Initially, the emotional Moon opposes transformative Pluto, so we may swing between personal wants and collective expectations until we slow down. By the Full Moon in Leo at 5:09 pm EST, we can name what our hearts want and show it clearly and respectfully. We may need to set up some rules for continuing conversations, but creativity is still the focal point. Trying something new and being wrong is better than not having tried it at all!

item.title: No. 2 UConn men’s basketball team rolls over Creighton, 85-58, in complete effort on the road
item.description: The UConn men's basketball team rolled to a dominant 85-58 victory over Creighton in front of an overflowing crowd at the CHI Health Center in Omaha.
